tests.name: filtering-projection
tests.description: The Filtering and projection functions: where(criteria), select(projection), repeat(projection), repeatAll(projection) (3.0.0 STU only) and ofType(type), with $this and $index inside criteria and projections, and what FHIR's FHIRPath page says about ofType() on FHIR types and choice elements. Leaves out what the text does not settle: a criteria that yields a single non-Boolean item, ofType() with a name that does not resolve or with an abstract or profiled FHIR type, whether ofType() keeps a FHIR type's specialisation (an Age for ofType(Quantity)), ofType() with a System type on FHIR primitives, whether System.Integer is a subclass of System.Decimal, unqualified System type names in a FHIR context, $index inside repeat(), infinite repetition, and the order repeat() and repeatAll() return. Also left out: the note contrasting repeat(item) with descendants().select(item), which rests on descendants() (another area), and the 3.0.0 Scoped Functions example Patient.name.select(given.join(' ').combine($this.family, true).join(', ')), which rests on join() and the STU combine(other, preserveOrder). The multi-item criteria error of where() is in the existence area. sort(), coalesce() and the instance selector, which 3.0.0 places in this section, are not covered.
